text:
mike_support: FYI - customer TKT-4927 reporting widespread 429s + model placement failures on Dedicated in eu-west2 since 08:00 UTC. They say requests time out then get billed. Can ops/eng triage? :warning:

kenji_eng: on it. do we have placement logs for that tenant? give me request ids.

mike_support: pasted sample x-reqs: rq_8f3a2, rq_8f3a7, rq_8f3b0. Customer says they see repeated 'placement_failed: NO_CAPACITY' then 429s from the gateway.

lukas_infra: seeing cluster pressure in eu-west2, GPU util ~98% on several pools, autoscaler delayed by ~6m due to provisioning throttles. noisy-tenant patterns emerging.

anya_ops: timeline: at 07:55 we started seeing placement denials for best-effort dedicated pools, at 08:02 routing attempted fallback to eu-west1 but a subset of requests failed auth during fallback (401). deploy-bot pushed a routing change at 08:03 to prefer na-west2 as secondary for this tenant.

kenji_eng: can you paste sample gateway error?

mike_support: here's a curl the customer used (sanitized):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \\n  -d '{"model":"redwood-large-dedicated","input":"hello"}' \\n  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```
response excerpts:
```
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
x-request-id: rq_8f3a2
body: {"error":"placement_failed","reason":"no_capacity_in_region"}

HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
body: {"error":"backpressure","retry_after":30}
```

kenji_eng: repro attempt from our staging tenant shows same placement_failed when forcing region eu-west2. logs: `allocator: deny placement tenant=acme-id reason=no_remaining_gpus`. autoscaler history shows scale-up requests stuck in 'pending_provision' due to cloud quota throttling.

anya_ops: billing-bot flagged duplicated billing events for that tenant at 08:05-08:12 (two charge events for same request ids). billing-bot: "possible double-bill on retry path".

billing-bot: flagged txn ids [txn_991, txn_992] - both tied to rq_8f3a2. Marked for manual review.

lukas_infra: short-term workaround: we can set tenant routing to prefer na-west2 and na-central for the next 30m for affected customer. That avoids eu-west2 saturation. Would need ops approval.

mike_support: customer wants immediate fix and refund for duplicate charges. I'll tell them we can route and investigate billing.

kenji_eng: technical plan: 1) confirm autoscaler quota unblocks with cloud partner 2) add temporary placement policy to avoid best-effort pools for this tenant (force reserved pool) 3) patch gateway to avoid producing double-bill on immediate retry path. I'll open a small PR for billing edge case.

anya_ops: done - routing change applied for tenant acme-id to prefer na-west2 at 08:20 UTC. I also created a one-off reserved allocation in eu-west2 for critical SLAs to reduce immediate 503s.

mike_support: customer confirms 08:28 they see reduced 503s but occasional 429s during high bursts. They've opened a support call asking for a refund for timestamps 08:02-08:12.

kenji_eng: generated repro steps for devs to reproduce locally: 1) create dedicated request with small batch size pinned to eu-west2 2) flood with 200 concurrent requests 3) watch allocator logs and gateway responses. sample allocator error snippet: ```allocator.go:245 deny allocation tenant=acme-id pool=best-effort region=eu-west2 reason=no_remaining_gpus```

lukas_infra: long-term: increase reserved capacity in eu-west2 and tune autoscaler backoff thresholds so scale-up won't be rate-limited by cloud provider. Also introduce finer-grained noisy-tenant eviction (soft-cull) to avoid starving others. Raising RFC.

mike_support: billing-bot, set TKT-4927 billing review + create refund request for txn_991/txn_992. Mark customer priority P1.

billing-bot: refund request created: REF-3345, escalated to finance.

kenji_eng: quick mitigation PR deployed to gateway to dedupe retry billing events on 403/5xx->retry path. rollout v1 -> v2 now. Monitor metrics for duplicate-charge errors.

anya_ops: monitoring: placement_denied_count spiked 08:00-08:10 ~x42. post-routing-change spike reduced by ~70% in the next 10m. still seeing autoscale_pending > 0 for eu-west2.

mike_support: summary for customer: we've routed your traffic away from saturated pools, filed refund request, and engineering is patching billing retry logic. Ops is coordinating capacity increase in eu-west2. I'll loop back once finance confirms refunds.

kenji_eng: followups: upload allocator traces to S3: s3://rwd-alloc-logs/2880001234/rq_8f3a2.trace, and assign eng ticket ENG-7231 to root cause autoscaler throttling.

mike_support: thanks team. tagging @oncall for overnight watch. :thumbsup:
